data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jean is recorded in name-lists as “God is gracious”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jean expresses “God is gracious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jean total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: יַן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יַן - אּר מןבי, הובר בר יל ילי וש יורין. יוי ור יורין אהר יל ושיל ובר ילי יברין.

in_greek.name: Ἰωάννης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰωάννης - ἅγιος, ζνπισ ελθι καππο πτη Σολο υπτό γένέσ γε νέππες υ γίνέρ υγώρη υτο υ πρεμον τε λεςσ.

in_latin.name: Iohannes
in_latin.long_meaning: Iohannes - nomen sanctum, origo a Ioannes, nomen Hebraicum significans Deus misericors, a Ioannes Apostolo et Evangelista. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Iohannes significat caritas, misericordia, et veritas.
